Show all the arithmetic operators on two numbers.

Supplied answer
a, b = 17, 5
print("Addition :", a + b) # 22
print("Subtraction :", a - b) # 12
print("Multiplication :", a * b) # 85
print("Division :", a / b) # 3.4 -> always float
print("Floor division :", a // b) # 3 -> drops the decimal
print("Modulus :", a % b) # 2 -> remainder
print("Power :", a ** b) # 1419857
Note: / gives a float, // gives the quotient, % gives the remainder.
